newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ATHLETICS-ROMANIAN COACH QUITS OVER DOPING SCANDAL.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-ROMANIAN COACH QUITS OVER DOPING SCANDAL.

text.p: Romanian athletics team trainer Dorin Melinte resigned on Thursday, saying he could not work in the atmosphere of suspicion following a positive drugs test by the country's top women's long distance runner.

Melinte said he had submitted his resignation after testifying at an enquiry into Iulia Negura's positive test for the steroid stanozolol at the European cross country championship she won in November.
"I think unidentified persons put the stanozolol in Negura's food," Melinte said by telephone. "I can no longer work in a suspicious atmosphere after this dirty case."

Negura faces a four-year ban under IAAF rules. "If the second test confirms the accusation against her, the federation will ban her for four years," said Iolanda Balas, Romanian Athletics Federation general secretary and former world high jump champion.

Melinte, who was once married to Los Angeles Olympic 800 metre champion Doina Melinte and acted as her trainer, is credited with masterminding Romania's successes in long-distance events over the past 15 years.
